rounds.text: Alankit Ltd trades at an exceptionally low price-to-book ratio of 0.69x, with a share price of ₹ 8.08 against a book value of ₹ 11.7 [E2], alongside a modest P/E multiple of 11.5 [E1] for a ₹ 219 Cr market capitalisation company [E3]. This valuation discount ignores a phenomenal long-term compounding track record, highlighted by a 27% compounded sales growth rate over 10 years [E8] and an 18% compounded profit growth rate over the same decade [E2]. Furthermore, medium-term profit growth remains solid at 14% over 5 years [E13], comfortably outpacing the sector median profit growth of 12.9% [E69]. Recent operational momentum is already visible as sales are up quarter-over-quarter [E61], and profit growth currently exceeds one-year price growth by 34% as the company begins to outperform expectations [E51].
